description: This file defines the PublisherRepository interface for data access operations related to Publisher entities in a Spring Data JPA context. It extends JpaRepository and includes methods to retrieve publishers by ID and to find all publishers, with entity graph annotations for fetching associated books.

classes.name: PublisherRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for Publisher entities, extending JpaRepository with custom fetch methods.

methods.name: findById(Long id)
methods.description: Retrieves a Publisher by its ID, including associated books through the entity graph.

methods.name: findAll()
methods.description: Fetches all Publisher records with associated books included.
